Diandre Sunner, PLA, shares how her path through horticulture shaped her approach to landscape architecture, the women who inspired her along the way, and more in ASLA’s Voices of Women in Landscape Architecture.
 
Give her feature a read at the link in our bio!

#SWpeople #landscapearchitecture

items.title: I Am Hosting a Do the DAN Event This Month!
items.description: On September 25th, I will get the opportunity to host an installment of PAL ’s Do the DAN event series! This series has included a lightning bug walk and talk on the Cottonwood Trail, sunrise tai chi at Hub City Gym, a frog walk on the River Birch, and more! Read onward to get more details about my event but feel free to go ahead and register here if you’d like to join us. Registering is not absolutely necessary but helps us see attendance and the first 50 to register will receive a Do the DAN x

items.title: Herald-Journal Site Developments
items.description: Concrete pouring might be complete on The Morgan Hotel (or very close).  Light steel framing has also begun on the 2nd floor.  Vertical steel beams appear to be up to the full 4 floors on the office building, though only the Main Street half of the building has been framed (not the Broad half yet).

items.title: New City/County Government Center
items.description: The official topping-out ceremony was today.  The building should be complete by the end of 2027, and occupied by early 2028. items.title: The City of Spartanburg, SC-Spartanburg County Joint Government Center officially reached its highest point earlier toda...
items.description: The City of Spartanburg, SC-Spartanburg County Joint Government Center officially reached its highest point earlier today during a topping out ceremony for the 219,000-square-foot facility, which will be the first-of-its-kind in S.C. Funded by the capital projects penny sales tax passed in 2017, the Joint Government Center will bring a new level of efficiency to local government, serving residents for decades to come.
